content: {"reasoning":"Required authorization is missing, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. There is no denial to appeal, but the initial claim can be submitted with supporting records to establish the payer’s determination and support medical necessity without treating records as a substitute for authorization. The payer path is not exhausted, so billing the full balance to the patient or writing it off is premature.","action":"submit_with_records"}
